annotations.text:
The gap: the board and the calendar both place CARDS. A card's tasks — body todos plus data.tasks, each already carrying startDate/dueDate — never appear on either surface.

This set makes the task a first-class citizen of both, without a second data model.
Everything here hangs off ONE new control: the Cards / Tasks / Both switch in the header. The board grows the same switch, so one board speaks one language.
Two directions I did not take, sketched so the choice is visible. Both are honest options — Alt B is much cheaper to build, Alt A is the better weekly planner.
